Modules

/courses/:courseId/modules
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S04

Show ordered instructional modules and precise access/completion requirements. Completion belongs to a specific learner and module, never a global checkbox shared between modules.

Keep completedReset completion
Permissions
  • Learners cannot see unpublished items unless an explicit published placeholder exists.
  • Staff preview reads a sample visibility context without changing actual learner progress.
  • TAs use authorized course visibility; module policy edits remain instructor-controlled here.
Responsive
  • Ordered module cards form one column with large disclosure targets.
  • Requirement explanations remain directly after their locked item on narrow web.
Accessibility
  • Disclosures expose expanded state and retain natural reading order.
  • Progress is text such as 2 of 5, not only a bar; links name item and type.
Data
  • Published module order/version, item types and availability rules.
  • Per-learner per-module requirement state, separate from assessment submission.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Completing an item in Module 3 does not complete Module 4.
  • Locked items cannot open by direct route before requirements are satisfied.
  • Failed completion acknowledgement leaves counts unchanged and offers retry.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
